title: Longest Common Subsequence
inputFormat:
Line 1: the string a.
Line 2: the string b.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest common subsequence of a and b (0 if there is none).
constraints:
1 <= |a|, |b| <= 1000
Both strings consist of lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: "ace" is a subsequence of both strings.
